searchText: what kind of restarts are you seeing ? <@476250636548308992> we’re seeing OOM restarts, which we increased memory and it seems to be better. But now we’re stuck due to a flood of errors for authority with untracked tx. Believe those errors are from Geth, not sure if anyone has any solutions there. Ah it might be that geth doesn't cleanup well after a restart cc <@543900561460822016> With Efforts moving to launching Hoodi, what does that mean for Holesky after hoodi is launched? Will still be supported in parallel no plans to shut it down or deprecate it right now Yeah it feels like holesky still has some teaching in it, we should see how the exit queue de-queues and we can decide what to do with it in future calls once pectra is through. We could use holesky for non-finality testing for e.g. In your opinions would Holesky be usable for testing custody functionality? So rpc calls for broadcasting and tracing transactions? Or do you all think it will be pretty unstable for that kind of testing? <@199561711278227457> <@476250636548308992> Holesky is fine for any sort of testing that doesnt rely on exits (and potentially deposits), definitely for the short term. However for anything related to transactions, we recommend using sepolia. Unfortunately we have use cases on both sides (running validators and transactional testin) that require us to use Holesky. But sounds like Holesky should be stable enough for the short term? Yes, it should be fine for the short term. Look into migrating to hoodi longer term. Trying to recreate this on my side. Shouldn't cause you to be stuck though since it only a txpool issue, unrelated to chain processing? Are you still having this issue? oh also <@782760001050902579> which version of geth are you running? there was an issue similar to this on geth <= 1.15.3, but was resolved in 1.15.4
